sections.title: 一、阅读理解 第一节 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Task: Protection of the Amazon(亚马孙)Rainforest Group: 7 Date: June 5, 2026 | | Research findings | Collected from | By whom | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **What** | the world's largest rainforest, about 5.5 million km² | English textbooks | Alan | | ^^ | average yearly temperature: about 27 ℃ | geography textbooks, | Ann | | ^^ | yearly rainfall: up to 2,700 mm | the internet | David | | ^^ | around 40,000 plant species(物种) | the internet | Emma | | **Why** | Situation: rainforest loss (about 51,800 km² a year)

questions.prompt: How many members are there in Group 7?
questions.translation: 第7组有多少名成员？
questions.explanation: 表格中“By whom”列出现的具体人名有 Alan、Ann、David 和 Emma，虽然有些任务由两人合作完成，但小组成员不重复计算，共计4人。故选 4.。'}

questions.prompt: What does David find online about the Amazon Rainforest?
questions.translation: 大卫在网上查到了关于亚马孙雨林的什么信息？
questions.explanation: 表格中“By whom”为 David，“Collected from”为 the internet，其对应的“Research findings”是“yearly rainfall: up to 2,700 mm”，由此可知 David 在网上查到的是亚马孙雨林的年降雨量。故选 The yearly rainfall.。

questions.prompt: Where are the ways of protecting the Amazon Rainforest collected from?
questions.translation: 保护亚马孙雨林的方法是从哪里收集来的？
questions.explanation: 表格中“How”（保护方法）一行，对应“Collected from”列明确指出信息来源于 digital magazines。故选 Digital magazines.。

questions.prompt: What is the text?
questions.translation: 这篇文章是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章标题为“Task”，表格中明确列出了“Research findings”（研究发现）、信息来源及人员分工，最后还有总结性的“Our Voice”，整体结构符合研究报告的特征。故选 A research report.。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 第一节 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
When our friends ask for help, we often agree without a second thought. Why do we do this? Usually, we say yes because we want to give a helping hand, bring joy to others, or be at peace with everyone. However, always saying yes to everything is not wise.

Does this mean we can always say no? The answer is clear. In some cases, to say yes is the only answer. For example, we must follow school rules. When it comes to keeping public safety and guarding national interests, we must say yes.

But when can we say no? We can say no if the request(请求) is unreasonable. Saying no can help us stick to what is right and <u>avert</u> unnecessary problems. After knowing when to say no, it is time to learn how to say no in a proper way.

Here are some ways to help us say no.

* **Start small.** Like any habit, saying yes to everything can be hard to break. We can begin by saying no to easier situations, and then practice more.
* **Don't say yes too early.** Tell others we need to check our plans first.
* **Keep answers short.** We don't need long excuses. A simple "No, I have other plans." is enough. Make sure we say it in a polite way.
* **Be brave.** If we must say yes, say it with an open heart. If we must say no, say it without fear. Saying no is not the same as being selfish(自私的). We also need to stand up for others and a better society.

questions.prompt: Why do we say yes when our friends ask for help?
options: To get on well with others.
To stay far away from joy.
questions.translation: 当我们的朋友寻求帮助时，我们为什么会答应？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Usually, we say yes because we want to give a helping hand, bring joy to others, or be at peace with everyone.”可知，我们答应是为了给他人提供帮助、带来快乐或与每个人和睦相处（get on well with others）。故选 To get on well with others.。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "<u>avert</u>" in Paragraph 3 mean?
questions.translation: 第3段中划线的单词“avert”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段句子“Saying no can help us stick to what is right and avert unnecessary problems.”可知，学会拒绝可以帮助我们坚持正确的事并避免不必要的麻烦，故划线词 avert 意为“避免”，与 avoid 同义。故选 Avoid.。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a proper way to say no according to the text?
questions.translation: 根据文章，以下哪种是恰当拒绝他人的方法？
questions.explanation: 根据文中方法第三点“Keep answers short. We don't need long excuses. A simple 'No, I have other plans.' is enough. Make sure we say it in a polite way.”可知，回答应礼貌且无需冗长的借口。故选 Reply politely without long excuses.。

questions.prompt: What does the writer encourage readers to do?
options: Say yes to the power of no.
Give way to the need of friends.
questions.translation: 作者鼓励读者做什么？
questions.explanation: 通读全文，作者主要阐述了在何时可以拒绝他人以及如何恰当地表达拒绝，鼓励读者认识并拥抱拒绝的力量（Say yes to the power of no）。故选 Say yes to the power of no.。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 第一节 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
[HTML:
Saturday, June 6
] Sometimes I wonder if the English I've learned at school is of any use in real life in English-speaking countries. I finally sent an email to my friend Eric about my doubt. To my surprise, he replied with a few words and lots of photos—street signs, shop boards, and public notices—all from his city. "See if you can understand..." he wrote in his email. So this whole afternoon, I sat at the desk and went through these photos. [HTML: ] The first sign reads "Thanks for standing in line while others exit. Keep it up!" From the words and the arrows(箭头), I could easily guess what "exit" means. It must mean "get out". While others are getting out, we should wait in line. "Keep it up!" might mean "Keep doing it!". It's good manners. [HTML: ] The second sign says "Dispose of or take your garbage with you. Leaving trash is a NO-GO!" It seemed difficult for me. "Garbage" and "trash" could mean something useless. But how about "Dispose of"? I looked it up in a dictionary. It says "to throw (something) away". It's our duty to put rubbish in a bin or take it away. So "Leaving trash is a NO-GO!" was not a problem for me. Everything made sense. Cool! [HTML: ] "Neighborhood", "watch" and "community" were not new to me, but I still failed to understand the last sign. Then I phoned my English teacher. She told me everyone in such a place worked together to keep the area safe. By guessing, using an English-English dictionary and asking for help, I got the meanings of all the photos. I can't wait to try more.

questions.prompt: What is the email to Eric mainly about?
questions.translation: 给埃里克的邮件主要是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 根据日记首段“Sometimes I wonder if the English I've learned at school is of any use in real life... I finally sent an email to my friend Eric about my doubt.”可知，作者给 Eric 的邮件主要是关于英语学习在现实中是否有用的疑问。故选 English learning.。

questions.prompt: Which of the following can take the place of "Leaving trash is a NO-GO!" in the text?
questions.translation: 文中哪一项可以代替“Leaving trash is a NO-GO!”？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段中作者的解释“It says 'to throw (something) away'. It's our duty to put rubbish in a bin or take it away. So 'Leaving trash is a NO-GO!' was not a problem for me.”可知，留下垃圾是绝对不行的，即“不能在这里乱扔垃圾”（You can't litter here!）。故选 You can't litter here!。

questions.prompt: How did the writer get the meaning of the last sign?
questions.translation: 作者是如何弄懂最后一个标识的含义的？
questions.explanation: 根据第五段“Then I phoned my English teacher. She told me everyone in such a place worked together to keep the area safe.”可知，作者是通过给英语老师打电话请教弄懂的。故选 By calling a teacher.。

questions.prompt: What is the writer most likely to do next?
questions.translation: 作者接下来最有可能做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“I got the meanings of all the photos. I can't wait to try more.”结合前文 Eric 发来照片帮助作者学习真实生活英语，可以推断作者接下来最可能会向 Eric 索要更多照片进行学习。故选 Ask Eric for more photos.。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 第一节 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Last summer, we visited a bank in Kunming, but this bank holds life instead of money. It's called the Germplasm Bank of Wild Species in Southwest China(中国西南野生生物种质资源库). Its seed(种子) bank, the largest one in Asia, keeps nearly 100,000 collections from over 11,000 kinds of wild plants.

We learned that many scientists made hard journeys to fill this bank. They climbed mountains, crossed highlands, and traveled through forests to collect valuable seeds. One scientist, Li Heng, led more than 20 trips to high mountains—even after the age of 61—and got badly hurt after falling from the back of a horse during her work. But nothing could stop her. She often said to her team, "Choose one thing, and give yourself to it." Another scientist, Guo Yongjie, collected seeds from Mount Qomolangma at 6,212 meters above sea level. This is the highest place ever for collecting plant seeds. He spent over 200 days a year in the wild, just to add one more kind of plant seed to the bank.

"A seed is hope," one scientist shared. These seeds are not just tiny plant parts; they carry genes(基因) that may help us grow better crops(庄稼), make new medicines, or bring back lost forests. But some kinds of plants are disappearing, and we may lose them forever. Therefore, collecting valuable seeds is a race against time. It is a job that needs patience, courage and love.

Saving seeds is everyone's job. Such seed banks are not only found in China. By working with seed banks in Norway, the UK, and some other countries around the world, the scientists can turn these treasures into a shared hope in the far future.

As we left, we had a deeper respect for the scientists who have spent their lives on this quiet but great work. The seeds they save carry life, hope, and a better future for all living things on the earth.

questions.prompt: What do the numbers in Paragraph 2 show?
questions.translation: 第2段中的数字展示了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中列举的数据“more than 20 trips”、“the age of 61”、“6,212 meters”、“over 200 days a year”可知，这些具体的数字展示了科学家们为收集珍贵种子所付出的巨大努力与艰辛。故选 The efforts of the scientists.。

questions.prompt: Why is collecting valuable seeds called "a race against time"?
options: Because the job is slowing down.
Because some plants are dying out.
questions.translation: 为什么收集珍贵的种子被称为“与时间赛跑”？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“But some kinds of plants are disappearing, and we may lose them forever. Therefore, collecting valuable seeds is a race against time.”可知，因为部分植物正在濒临灭绝（dying out），如果不抢先保存就会永远失去。故选 Because some plants are dying out.。

questions.prompt: What can help scientists save seeds according to Paragraph 4?
questions.translation: 根据第4段，什么能够帮助科学家保存种子？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“By working with seed banks in Norway, the UK, and some other countries around the world, the scientists can turn these treasures into a shared hope...”可知，通过与世界多国种子库展开国际合作（Cooperating internationally）能有效保存种子。故选 Cooperating internationally.。

questions.prompt: What is the best title(标题) for the text?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文主要介绍了中国西南野生生物种质资源库及其科学家抢救保存种子的壮举，文中多次出现“A seed is hope”、“shared hope”、“seeds carry life, hope...”，选项“希望之种”（Seeds of hope）最能概括文章的核心主旨。故选 Seeds of hope。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 第二节 (阅读还原)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
You might imagine that poetry(诗歌) isn't for people like you. You might even have a picture in your mind of what a real poet looks like. [1] The sooner you free yourself on the page, the more exciting the process(过程) becomes. How can you turn your story into a poem? Let us share some advice on how to get started.

**Let go of the "shoulds".** You likely have an idea of what poetry is supposed to look like. But long words, difficult sentences and strict verses(诗节) are not a must if that's not your style. [2] Most people think that all poetry must be deep, but poetry can be about anything important in your daily life. Your friend gives you a hug when you feel down. Your classmate gives you a high five when you score a goal. If it's real to you, it can become a part of your poem.

**Try these poetry exercises.** If you want to try writing a poem, start exactly where you are right now. Your first poem might be terrible. [3] But your third? Your 10th? Nobody knows what you might discover about yourself in the process. You might try writing list poems and short poems, or you might try writing a poem to tell a story.

**The true purpose of poetry is self-expression.** So, maybe it's time to stop waiting for the right moment or the right level of skill. [4]
wordbank: Maybe it's time to just begin.
Find a chance to listen to your daily stories.
But as a matter of fact, everyone can be a poet.

questions.translation: 空格[1]还原选项
questions.explanation: 前文提到人们常误以为诗歌不适合自己，对诗人有刻板印象，此处需要打破认知，选项“But as a matter of fact, everyone can be a poet.”承上启下，引出每个人都可以创作诗歌。故选 But as a matter of fact, everyone can be a poet.。'}

questions.translation: 空格[2]还原选项
questions.explanation: 后文列举了朋友拥抱、同学击掌等日常生活中的小事，强调诗歌可以取材于日常点滴，选项“Write about the everyday moments.”（记录日常时刻）精准概括了本段核心建议。故选 Write about the everyday moments.。'}

questions.translation: 空格[3]还原选项
questions.explanation: 前句说第一首诗可能很糟糕（might be terrible），后文转折提到第三首、第十首可能会有惊喜，选项“Your second might be worse.”在第一首与第三首之间构成生动有趣的递进。故选 Your second might be worse.。'}

questions.translation: 空格[4]还原选项
questions.explanation: 前文指出不要再等待完美的时机或成熟的技巧，结尾呼吁立即行动，选项“Maybe it's time to just begin.”顺承上文，鼓励读者立刻动笔。故选 Maybe it's time to just begin.。'}

sections.title: 二、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，理解其大意，从 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
One sunny weekend, Mr White, a sailing teacher, took his son Tom for their usual sailing practice.

[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 227 255" width="125" height="140" style="display:block; margin:0 auto; border-radius:4px;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><image href="data:image/webp;base64," x="0" y="0" width="227" height="255" /></svg>]

On arriving at the beach, they put on their life jackets. Then their [21] began. When Tom sailed, his father followed in his own boat, keeping a close eye on him.

The [22] wind filled the sail and Tom's sailboat moved gently in the calm water. Tom [23] that sailing would be easy as usual. He nodded at his father happily.

Some time later, a sudden wind came out of nowhere. It was so strong that Tom's sailboat was pushed in another direction. Not ready for the change, Tom lost his [24] and couldn't control his sailboat. He fell into the water, all wet. His sailboat [25] , floating(漂浮) on the surface of water.

"Help!" Tom shouted in [26] .

"Take it easy. You're safe. Try to right the boat," said his father.

Tom tried several times, but it didn't [27] . "I can't!" Tom cried, shaking all over.

"Calm down. Do as I taught you before," his father said in a loud voice.

Tom [28] to the daggerboard in the middle of the sailboat. He pushed it down hard. The sailboat moved a little.

"Push it harder," his father added.

Tom had another try and the sailboat was almost out of water. Courage [29] in his heart. With a final effort, Tom turned the sailboat upright(竖立着).

Tom held the side of the sailboat and [30] climbed back onto it. "I made it!" Tom cheered.

As Tom's sailboat moved forward again, his father wore a smile on his face, still keeping a close eye on Tom.

questions.translation: 空格[21]填空
questions.explanation: 文章首段提到父子俩前去进行“usual sailing practice”（日常帆船练习），穿好救生衣后练习（practice）便正式开始。故选 practice。

questions.translation: 空格[22]填空
questions.explanation: 根据后文“moved gently in the calm water”（在平静的水面缓缓前行）可知此时的风是柔和的（soft）。故选 soft。

questions.translation: 空格[23]填空
questions.explanation: 看到水面平静、航行顺利，汤姆认为（thought）帆船运动会像往常一样简单。故选 thought。

questions.translation: 空格[24]填空
questions.explanation: 突如其来的强风使船身晃动，汤姆措手不及失去了平衡（lost his balance），跌入水中。故选 balance。

questions.translation: 空格[25]填空
questions.explanation: 根据后文父亲指导汤姆“Try to right the boat”（把船扶正）可知，帆船翻了（turned over）。故选 turned over。

questions.translation: 空格[26]填空
questions.explanation: 汤姆落水受惊，浑身发抖，在恐惧（in fear）中大声呼救。故选 fear。

questions.translation: 空格[27]填空
questions.explanation: 根据“I can't! Tom cried”可知，汤姆尝试了几次但都没有奏效/起作用（didn't work）。故选 work。

questions.translation: 空格[28]填空
questions.explanation: 汤姆身在水里，需要游向（swam to）船身中间的稳向板。故选 swam。

questions.translation: 空格[29]填空
questions.explanation: 看到船身有所转动，汤姆心中的勇气增长了（courage grew in his heart）。故选 grew。

questions.translation: 空格[30]填空
questions.explanation: 把船扶正后，汤姆抓住船舷迅速（quickly）爬回了船上。故选 quickly。

sections.title: 三、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给词的正确形式填空，使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
I've photographed Africa's wild places for more than 30 years. For me, it is not a hobby [31] a career(事业).

Every time I take photos of the landscape and wildlife, I focus on my relationship [32] light. From the first light before sunrise to the soft celebration of day's end, taking photos in Africa brings me much pleasure.

The moment before sunrise is my favorite time of day. I can see [33] sky change from black to deep blue as warm colors begin to appear. Some animals are still [34] (act) enough to move around. At this moment, it's possible to take great photos of animals. If such photos [35] (take) in a fine mist(薄雾), there seems to be magic in them.

At noon, most people return to camp during the heat. With fewer people around, I have [36] (many) chances than other people to take amazing photos. But I need to be patient. Sometimes I have to wait for a long time in the heat [37] (get) a perfect photo.

On a starry night, it is also possible to take nice photos. I remember that I [38] (see) a large herd(群) of elephants crossing a river on a clear night eight [39] (month) ago. I knew that was a moment I [40] (simple) couldn't afford to miss. Today, I'm still proud of those photos I took that night.

I love everything about my career as a photographer. I will keep running after the light.

questions.translation: 对我来说，这不是一个爱好，而是一项事业。
questions.explanation: not... but... 是固定搭配，意为“不是……而是……”，表转折对比。故选 but。

questions.translation: 我会专注于我和光线之间的联结。
questions.explanation: relationship with sth. 意为“与……的关系”，为固定介词搭配。故选 with。

questions.translation: 我能看见天空随着暖色调慢慢显现，从黑色转变为深蓝色。
questions.explanation: sky（天空）是世界上独一无二的事物，前需加定冠词 the。故选 the。

questions.translation: 一些动物仍然活跃到足以四处活动。
questions.explanation: 系动词 are 后面需要填形容词作表语，act 的形容词形式为 active（活跃的）。故选 active。

questions.translation: 如果这样的照片是在薄雾中拍摄的，画面仿佛蕴含着魔力。
questions.explanation: 主语 such photos 与 take 之间是被动关系，且在 if 引导的条件状语从句中描述客观规律用一般现在时的被动语态 are taken。故选 are taken。

questions.translation: 我就能比其他人拥有更多机会拍出惊艳的照片。
questions.explanation: 根据空格后的比较级标志词 than 可知，此处应用 many 的比较级 more。故选 more。

questions.translation: 有时我不得不在酷暑中等很久，只为拍出一张完美的照片。
questions.explanation: 此处表示等待的目的，应用动词不定式 to get 作目的状语。故选 to get。

questions.translation: 我记得八个月前一个晴朗的夜晚，我看到一大群大象正在渡河。
questions.explanation: 时间状语 eight months ago 表示过去的时间，谓语动词需用一般过去时 saw。故选 saw。

questions.translation: 八个月前一个晴朗的夜晚。
questions.explanation: 数词 eight 后接可数名词的复数形式 months。故选 months。

questions.translation: 我知道那是一个我万万不能错过的瞬间。
questions.explanation: 修饰情态动词短语 couldn't afford to miss 需要使用副词 simply（简直、完全）。故选 simply。

sections.title: 四、阅读与表达 (任务型阅读)
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的材料，根据内容选出最佳答案（根据中考规则，主观问答题已升级转换为标准客观选项模式）。
sections.passage:
Travel is more than just visiting new places, it's a special journey to relax and explore new things. You can get close to nature, experience local cultures and meet different people. The most meaningful part of travel, without doubt, is to achieve personal growth.

When you choose a place to travel, think about what you want. If you love nature, a small village with green hills and clear rivers will probably surprise you. If you are curious about history, you can go to an ancient city. If you want answers to your questions about robots, a science museum might be a great choice.

Traveling with different people brings different kinds of happiness. Going with friends allows you to share laughter and interesting stories. Going with family warms your heart with care and love. Traveling alone helps you become braver and know yourself better.

No matter where you go and who you go with, safety comes first. Remember to book rides through trusted services. Be sure to keep in touch with your family during your travel. When a situation feels dangerous, you should change plans.

Travel teaches you to be brave, open-minded and thankful. It is an amazing experience. Recording the travel is also important. There are many ways to record the travel. Probably you have a good way of your own to keep sweet memories(回忆).

questions.prompt: What is the most meaningful part of travel?
options: To spend all the money on gifts.
To take photos without looking around.
To stay in hotels all day long.
questions.translation: 旅行中最有意义的部分是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段最后一句“The most meaningful part of travel, without doubt, is to achieve personal growth.”可知，最有意义的部分是获得个人成长。故选 To achieve personal growth.。

questions.prompt: How does traveling alone help you?
options: It helps me become braver and know myself better.
It makes me feel lonely and lose my way.
It forces me to avoid making any new friends.
It stops me from exploring nature freely.
questions.translation: 独自旅行对你有什么帮助？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段最后一句“Traveling alone helps you become braver and know yourself better.”可知，独自旅行能帮助人变得更勇敢、更了解自己。故选 It helps me become braver and know myself better.。

questions.prompt: Which of the following lists two ways that can keep you safe for your travel?
options: Booking rides through trusted services and keeping in touch with family.
Traveling only at midnight and taking unknown paths.
Turning off mobile phones and leaving without notices.
Refusing to change plans even in dangerous situations.
questions.translation: 以下哪一项列出了两条能在旅行中保障安全的措施？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“Remember to book rides through trusted services. Be sure to keep in touch with your family during your travel.”可知，通过可信渠道叫车以及与家人保持联系是保障安全的有效措施。故选 Booking rides through trusted services and keeping in touch with family.。

questions.prompt: What is your way to record your travel? Give your reason(s). (Select the statement that best matches the writing requirements)
options: I like keeping a travel diary every day. Writing down my true feelings and wonderful moments helps me remember the warm details clearly. It is a good way to keep sweet travel memories for the future.
I do not like traveling at all because it is too tiring and expensive.
Taking photos is boring so I never record anything during my trips.
I only buy souvenirs in gift shops when I arrive at the airport.
questions.translation: 你记录旅行的方式是什么？给出你的理由。（选择最符合要求的一项）
questions.explanation: 选项A明确提出了“写旅行日记”的方式，并详细阐述了记录真实感受、珍藏美好回忆等充分理由，语句通顺连贯且字数达到30词以上，完全契合中考参考答案范例与评估标准。B、C表达消极且未给出记录方式，D未说明理由且字数不足。
